trust_decision.summary: Whether an OIDC login with no issuer/subject match may be linked to an existing local account by its email claim is decided in fallbackSearchUsers, which at the pinned commit trusts cl.Email whenever the provider has EmailFallback enabled and never reads email_verified (the claims struct has no such field).

landing_point.why: The summary names 'OIDC email-fallback account linking'; grepping EmailFallback leads straight to the `if provider.EmailFallback` branch in fallbackSearchUsers, whose comment already warns about unverified emails (openid.go:388).

fix_sites.entry_point: POST /api/v1/auth/openid/{provider}/callback and v2 POST /auth/openid/{provider}/callback, via getClaims decoding the ID token / userinfo into claims (pkg/modules/auth/openid/openid.go:548, pkg/modules/auth/openid/openid.go:562)
fix_sites.module_kind: claims schema / JSON decoder (new boolish type and EmailVerified field)

fix_sites.entry_point: same OIDC callbacks -> AuthenticateCallback -> getOrCreateUser -> fallbackSearchUsers (pkg/modules/auth/openid/openid.go:230, pkg/modules/auth/openid/openid.go:446)
same OIDC callbacks -> fallbackSearchUsers email-only lookup (pkg/modules/auth/openid/openid.go:413-414)
same OIDC callbacks -> getClaims -> mergeClaims when userinfo is fetched (pkg/modules/auth/openid/openid.go:554-568)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: pkg/modules/auth/openid/openid.go:509-512 (mergeClaims replaces cl.Email with the userinfo email; the fix makes email_verified travel with it, fix.diff:75)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: mergeClaims only merges profile fields and is not the linking code; a solver who adds EmailVerified to claims and gates fallbackSearchUsers will see their test (ID-token claims only) pass and argue the userinfo merge is a profile-sync detail, not part of account linking.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: A verified email must still link to the existing local account (EmailFallback is a supported feature); with EmailFallback+UsernameFallback and an unverified email the fix degrades to username-only lookups instead of refusing; an unverified login still creates a separate new OIDC account rather than erroring; providers sending email_verified as the string "true"/"1" must still link.

O6_input_shapes: email_verified absent or of another type (treated as false)
email from the ID token vs email taken from the userinfo endpoint (merge route)
EmailFallback alone (email-only lookup) vs EmailFallback combined with UsernameFallback (email ANDed into username lookups)

O7_producer.where: pkg/modules/auth/openid/openid.go:80-88 (claims struct decoded via idToken.Claims at pkg/modules/auth/openid/openid.go:548 and info.Claims at pkg/modules/auth/openid/openid.go:562, merged at pkg/modules/auth/openid/openid.go:509-543)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: An already-linked OIDC user's local email is overwritten with the unverified cl.Email on each login; a sibling email-based lookup (e.g. a 'link existing account by email' step for returning users) could reuse it.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The profile-sync branch already copies the email without any verification, so a maintainer adding a second email-matching path would naturally read u.Email/cl.Email the same way.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: An LDAP email fallback that links a new LDAP login to an existing local account by the directory mail attribute, mirroring OIDC EmailFallback.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: getOrCreateLdapUser already follows the same lookup-then-create shape as getOrCreateUser; adding a fallback lookup here mirrors the OIDC feature, and the gate would have to live in a different package from the OIDC fix.

O9_family: authentication bypass via unverified identity attribute (OIDC email account linking / CWE-287, CWE-290, CWE-345)

O10_build.project_tests: pkg/modules/auth/openid/openid_test.go (TestGetOrCreateUser at :33 with db fixtures, TestMergeClaims at :387); getOrCreateUser and mergeClaims are tested directly without a live IdP

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add `EmailVerified bool `json:"email_verified"`` to claims and skip the email-only lookup when it is false, missing string-typed email_verified (which then fails the whole claims decode), the combined username+email lookups and the userinfo merge.

out_of_scope_notes: UsernameFallback links to any local account by sub/preferred_username with no verification claim (pkg/modules/auth/openid/openid.go:397-408); documented as a hijack risk in config-raw.json:770, so it is a separate admin-opt-in risk, not this advisory's protection.

New OIDC users are created with an unverified email, and the email uniqueness check is skipped for non-local issuers (pkg/modules/auth/openid/openid.go:468, pkg/user/user_create.go:243-245); the downstream email-keyed lookups (e.g. pkg/user/user_password_reset.go:110) are a different sink.
